subject: general
question: The Tapi River originates from which of the following ranges?
solution: The correct answer is __**Satpura**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Tapi River**, also known as the Tapti River, originates from the **Satpura range** in Madhya Pradesh, India. • It emerges near **Multai**, which is located in the Betul district of Madhya Pradesh. Multai is also referred to as the "source of Tapti." • The Satpura range is a series of hills and mountains that run parallel to the Vindhya range in central India. • The Tapi River flows westward, which is a unique feature as most rivers in India flow eastward into the Bay of Bengal. The Tapi flows into the **Arabian Sea**. • Covering a course of approximately **724 km**, the Tapi River passes through Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Gujarat before draining into the Arabian Sea.
